queries.compiledQueryString:
select
  month_start,
  term,
  n_postings_with_term,
  mentions,
  n_postings_month,
  share_postings_with_term,
  mentions_per_posting
from usajobs.AGGR_DEIKeyTermsByMonth
where term = case
  when '${inputs.dei_term.value}' in ('deia', 'diversity', 'equity', 'inclusion')
    then '${inputs.dei_term.value}'
  else 'diversity'
end
order by month_start

queries.compiledQueryString:
with latest_month as (
  select max(month_start) as month_start
  from usajobs.AGGR_DEIKeyTermsByMonth
),
latest as (
  select
    term,
    n_postings_with_term,
    mentions,
    n_postings_month,
    share_postings_with_term,
    mentions_per_posting
  from usajobs.AGGR_DEIKeyTermsByMonth
  where month_start = (select month_start from latest_month)
)
select *
from latest
order by mentions_per_posting desc, mentions desc
